text: In addition to appointing members representing Indigenous communities, people with lived experience, youth, and the Board of Health, the Toronto Urban Health Fund Review Panel requires the Board of Health to appoint a City Councillor.

The Board of Health: 1. Appointed Councillor Kristyn Wong-Tam as the City Council member on the 2018 Toronto Urban Health Fund Review Panel for a term of office ending on November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.
